hero.title: Aspects
hero.subtitle: Aspects are the angles formed between planets in your birth chart. They reveal how planetary energies interact — whether they flow harmoniously, create productive tension, or demand constant adjustment.

orb_note: Orbs used in Spellful's birth chart calculator: Conjunction 8°, Sextile 6°, Square 8°, Trine 8°, Opposition 8°, Quincunx 3°. Tighter orbs indicate stronger influence.
applying_body: An applying aspect is one where the faster planet is moving toward the exact angle — its influence is building and felt most strongly. A separating aspect has already reached exactness and is moving apart — its energy is waning. Both are significant, but applying aspects carry more urgency.
